outcome: Hospitalizations during the first year of life
cohort: The study included all 696,900 live births in British Columbia (BC), Canada, from fiscal years 2004-2005 to 2019-2020, of which 2,439 infants were diagnosed with NAS.
finding: While unadjusted data showed increased post-discharge infant mortality and hospitalizations among infants with NAS, these associations diminished after adjustment for maternal and socio-medical conditions, suggesting NAS itself is not independently associated with increased infant mortality, though infants with NAS did have a disproportionately higher rate of placement in foster care.
